current_preprint_scope.statement: Current preprint scope: fixed-cell + certified 8/16 only. No 32/64 publish; no manuscript/certificate/release edits from this ring.

matched_point_and_box.detail: Point return and full box/C1 return must be strictly matched (center, model, scales, C, q, all derivative columns). Reuse of a completed point is allowed only after that strict match with the authorized box radius (currently 3e-10 for the active 32-site attempt).

inclusion.detail: Strict componentwise K inclusion / validated C1 covering inclusion for the claimed set. Partial tubes do not close inclusion.

period_exclusions.detail: Independent audit of complete time/branch/tube coverage, ascending-section exclusions, and all nonidentity cyclic shifts. T=N*tau is a physical period only once the root exists; fundamental period requires earlier-return exclusion. Disjoint initial voltage boxes prove nonsynchrony alone, not existence or period.

K_and_Lyapunov.detail: After existence: separately audited initial field and full C1 flow covering the proved K set (or sufficient matched uniform derivative). Exact H SPD and q^2 H - DP^T H DP SPD via separately justified square rational congruences, LDL, or weighted dominance. A numerical eigensolver or H positivity alone does not prove stability. No conditional K derivative may replace the original uniform existence derivative.

independent_product_positivity_replay.detail: Independent exact outward dyadic/GMP product replay of residuals, DP bounds, and positivity/SPD claims. Reject Python-O, missing/incomplete/rounded/point-only/wrong-shift, and stale source inputs. Use recomputed quantities, not saved success Booleans.

uncertified_rule.statement: All partial/failed runs remain uncertified. A partial flow, source admission, numerical candidate, positive metric alone, or saved success Boolean is not a theorem.

do_not: call numerical resolution a continuum result
